scope: one-host physical execution recovery after fork/crash

coordination.overlap_policy: PR243 closed unmerged after evidence; PR246 is regression-only; explicit pass_fds/exec class left to PR242 worker

fresh_external_primary_evidence.fact: forked file descriptors refer to the same open file description as the parent
flock locks are associated with open file descriptions; duplicate descriptors share the lock and it persists until unlock or all duplicate descriptors close
Python exposes child/parent callbacks around fork for Python-mediated forks
pidfds provide a process-lifetime reference and avoid PID reuse ambiguity for supported process-lifetime observations

hypothesis.statement: A process-PID-bound Gate lease can correctly deny fork-child effect authority while still leaving recovery unavailable if the child retains the inherited flock-backed open-file-description after the issuing parent hard-crashes.

strongest_counterhypothesis.statement: Process-incarnation authority fencing alone is sufficient because inherited physical lock lifetime cannot outlive the issuing process in a way that blocks a fresh physical contender.

go_out_of_box_experiment.test: real Gate acquire -> fork child -> issuing parent os._exit(23) without release -> child performs no lease method and stays alive -> fresh physical-lock probe before/after child exit

executed_target_evidence.interpretation: The old v5 lineage solved fork-child authority inheritance but not physical-holder lifetime/recovery. Authority and availability are distinct continuity dimensions.

current_main_refresh.observed_mechanism: Gate-issued leases carry process incarnation; os.register_at_fork child hook detaches/closes inherited Gate anchor/runtime resources without LOCK_UN or semantic release and rotates child process incarnation.

fresh_main_regression.required_result: physical anchor reacquires while detached fork child is still alive

parallel_pass_fds_lane.repository_search_observation: No pass_fds or subprocess.Popen hit was found in the indexed current Dr.-Unterweger product repository during this run; production reachability therefore remains unproven by this worker.
parallel_pass_fds_lane.disposition: DO_NOT_DUPLICATE; await independent exact target/reachability evidence

architecture_delta.reason: Current main already contains a stronger Gate-level at-fork detach mechanism that directly targets the reproduced normal-fork liveness class. Evidence should first validate that existing repair. Separate pass_fds/exec reachability must be established before introducing another lock architecture.
architecture_delta.test_obligation: Retain fork-orphan crash recovery as a permanent current-main regression if PR246 passes; preserve historical PR243 as negative evidence.

negative_results: PID/process-incarnation authority fencing does not by itself guarantee recovery availability when inherited physical descriptors remain open.
A green authority regression must not be promoted as recovery/liveness evidence without a hard-crash + surviving-descendant discriminator.
next_frontier: Classify exact target PR246 fresh-main recovery regression.
Keep explicit descriptor-export/exec reachability separate and consume PR242 evidence rather than duplicating it.
Fuse only target-supported execution-generation/physical-lock/recovery evidence into the F-V01-09 fresh-main effect-fence integration lane.
Do not merge historical PR243 or overwrite newer main semantics.
